reseeded_note: Reference row RESEEDED 2026-08-06. This model rides an implicit-ALS basis that was previously constructed with no random_state, so every run produced a different basis and the stored value was one unreproducible draw -- which also meant run_arm_n.py's per-row snap gate could not distinguish 'the harness changed' from 'a different random draw', the exact failure it exists to detect. ials.py now pins random_state=98765. These values are the arm-A block of the seeded arm-N run, i.e. the canonical protocol computed from the same fitted model as the arm-N row. The previous unreproducible values are preserved under superseded_unseeded/.
